attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Charge and start attacking
macros.desc: Get off your mount, start swinging and Charge in one press.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Charge
/dismount
/startattack
/cast Charge
macros.needs: Battle Stance (Defensive Stance with Vanguard); out of combat
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Investida
/dismount
/startattack
/cast Investida

macros.title: Charge out of combat, Intercept in it
macros.desc: Charge from Battle Stance out of combat and Intercept from Berserker Stance in combat. If you're in the wrong stance the press swaps first, then press again.
macros.code:
#show [combat] Intercept; Charge
/startattack
/cast [nocombat,stance:1] Charge; [combat,stance:3] Intercept; [nocombat,nostance:1] Battle Stance; [combat,nostance:3] Berserker Stance
macros.needs: Charge and Intercept learned
macros.codePt:
#show [combat] Interceptar; Investida
/startattack
/cast [nocombat,stance:1] Investida; [combat,stance:3] Interceptar; [nocombat,nostance:1] Postura de Batalha; [combat,nostance:3] Postura de Berserker

macros.title: Victory Rush after a kill
macros.desc: Use the new follow-up strike within 20 seconds of defeating a non-trivial enemy; it also heals you for 10% of your maximum health.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Victory Rush
/startattack
/cast Victory Rush
macros.needs: Victory Rush learned; a qualifying recent kill
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ímpeto da Vitória
/startattack
/cast Ímpeto da Vitória

macros.title: Berserker Rage with a stance swap
macros.desc: Swap into Berserker Stance if you aren't in it and use Berserker Rage, which makes you immune to Fear and Incapacitate for 10 sec.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Berserker Rage
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast Berserker Rage
macros.needs: Berserker Stance. Learned at 30
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raiva Incontrolada
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast Raiva Incontrolada

macros.title: Execute your target or mouseover
macros.desc: Start attacking and Execute a target under 20% health, or your mouseover with Shift. From Defensive Stance it swaps to Battle Stance first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Execute
/startattack
/cast [stance:2] Battle Stance
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Execute; Execute
macros.needs: Battle or Berserker Stance; target under 20% health
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Executar
/startattack
/cast [stance:2] Postura de Batalha
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Executar; Executar

macros.title: Heroic Strike or Cleave
macros.desc: Start attacking and queue Heroic Strike on your next swing, or Cleave with Shift when a second enemy is close by.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cleave; Heroic Strike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Cleave; Heroic Strike

keys.text: Queue Heroic Strike on your next swing

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cutilada; Golpe Heroico
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Cutilada; Golpe Heroico

macros.title: Use both trinkets
macros.desc: Use your top and bottom trinkets together.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use 13
/use 14
macros.needs: Trinkets equipped in both slots
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use 13
/use 14

macros.title: Bloodrage and a Rage Potion
macros.desc: Bloodrage and a Rage Potion together, so the potion's 20 to 40 Rage lands on top of Bloodrage's.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bloodrage
/cast Bloodrage
/use Rage Potion
macros.needs: Rage Potion in your bags (an Alchemy craft)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fúria Sanguinária
/cast Fúria Sanguinária
/use Poção de Raiva

macros.title: Battle Shout, Shift for Demoralizing Shout
macros.desc: Refresh Battle Shout, or hold Shift to weaken nearby enemies with Demoralizing Shout. You choose which shout to spend Rage on.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Demoralizing Shout; Battle Shout
/cast [mod:shift] Demoralizing Shout; Battle Shout
macros.needs: Both shouts learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Brado Desmoralizador; Brado de Batalha
/cast [mod:shift] Brado Desmoralizador; Brado de Batalha

macros.title: Overpower stance
macros.desc: Swap to Battle Stance if you aren't in it, then Overpower after a dodge or when Bloodthrill opens the window. If you swap, press again to cast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Overpower
/startattack
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
/cast Overpower
macros.needs: Battle Stance; target dodged or a Bloodthrill proc; Overpower learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Subjugar
/startattack
/cast [nostance:1] Postura de Batalha
/cast Subjugar

macros.title: Spearing Strike
macros.desc: Start swinging and use Spearing Strike, which hits Giants, Dragonkin and mounted enemies harder and dismounts riders.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Spearing Strike
/startattack
/cast Spearing Strike
macros.needs: Spearing Strike talent; Battle Stance. The October 1 update removed the two-handed weapon requirement
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Lanceador
/startattack
/cast Golpe Lanceador

macros.title: Victory Rush, Overpower, Mortal Strike
macros.desc: One button for whatever is ready: Victory Rush after a kill, Overpower when Bloodthrill or a dodge opens it, then Mortal Strike.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mortal Strike
/startattack
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
/cast Victory Rush
/cast Overpower
/cast Mortal Strike
macros.needs: Mortal Strike talent; Battle Stance; Bloodthrill talent for the extra Overpower windows
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Mortal
/startattack
/cast [nostance:1] Postura de Batalha
/cast Ímpeto da Vitória
/cast Subjugar
/cast Golpe Mortal

macros.title: Mortal Strike, Hamstring on Shift
macros.desc: Start attacking and use Mortal Strike, or Hamstring with Shift to slow a runner.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Hamstring; Mortal Strike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Hamstring; Mortal Strike
macros.needs: Mortal Strike talent; Battle Stance for Hamstring
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cortar Tendão; Golpe Mortal
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Cortar Tendão; Golpe Mortal

macros.title: Rend your target or mouseover
macros.desc: Start attacking and Rend your target, or your mouseover with Shift. Bloodthrill only works on enemies that have your Rend on them.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Rend
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Rend; Rend
macros.needs: Battle or Defensive Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Dilacerar
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Dilacerar; Dilacerar

macros.title: Sweeping Strikes with a stance swap
macros.desc: Swap to Battle Stance if you need to and start Sweeping Strikes, so your next 5 melee attacks hit a second enemy.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Sweeping Strikes
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
/cast Sweeping Strikes
macros.needs: Sweeping Strikes talent; it needs Battle Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpes a Esmo
/cast [nostance:1] Postura de Batalha
/cast Golpes a Esmo

macros.title: Charge, then Hamstring
macros.desc: Charge when you're out of combat, and once you're fighting the same key Hamstrings.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [nocombat] Charge; Hamstring
/startattack
/cast [nocombat] Charge
/cast Hamstring
macros.needs: Battle Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [nocombat] Investida; Cortar Tendão
/startattack
/cast [nocombat] Investida
/cast Cortar Tendão

macros.title: Retaliation with a stance swap
macros.desc: Swap to Battle Stance if needed and use Retaliation: up to 30 melee counterattacks over 15 sec. Its 15 minute cooldown is independent of Shield Wall and Recklessness.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Retaliation
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
/cast Retaliation
macros.needs: Battle Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Retaliação
/cast [nostance:1] Postura de Batalha
/cast Retaliação

macros.title: Swap to your two-hander
macros.desc: Equip your two-hander and drop into Battle Stance. Put your own weapon's name where it says Two-Hander Name.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Battle Stance
/equip Two-Hander Name
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
macros.needs: A two-handed weapon in your bags
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Postura de Batalha
/equip Nome da Arma de Duas Mãos
/cast [nostance:1] Postura de Batalha

macros.title: Bloodthirst and auto attack
macros.desc: Start your swings and use Bloodthirst, which now also gives 10% movement speed for 10 sec. Hold Shift to queue Heroic Strike as well.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bloodthirst
/startattack
/cast Bloodthirst
/cast [mod:shift] Heroic Strike
macros.needs: Bloodthirst talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sede de Sangue
/startattack
/cast Sede de Sangue
/cast [mod:shift] Golpe Heroico

macros.title: Whirlwind stance
macros.desc: Enter Berserker Stance if you need to and use Whirlwind. If it only swaps stance, press again.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Whirlwind
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast Whirlwind
macros.needs: Berserker Stance and Whirlwind learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Redemoinho
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast Redemoinho

macros.title: Execute, Bloodthirst, Whirlwind
macros.desc: One button for whatever is ready: Execute under 20% health, then Bloodthirst, then Whirlwind.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Bloodthirst
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast Execute
/cast Bloodthirst
/cast Whirlwind
macros.needs: Bloodthirst talent; Berserker Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Sede de Sangue
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast Executar
/cast Sede de Sangue
/cast Redemoinho

macros.title: Whirlwind into Cleave
macros.desc: Whirlwind now strikes with both weapons without a talent, and Cleave on the next swing catches the second enemy too.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Whirlwind
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast Whirlwind
/cast Cleave
macros.needs: Berserker Stance; a second enemy close by
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Redemoinho
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast Redemoinho
/cast Cutilada

macros.title: Death Wish then Recklessness
macros.desc: First press starts Death Wish, the next starts Recklessness, and both trinkets fire each time. Death Wish now makes you take 5% more damage.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=30 Death Wish, Recklessness
/use 13
/use 14
macros.needs: Death Wish talent; Berserker Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=30 Desejo de Matar, Temeridade
/use 13
/use 14

macros.title: Recklessness from any stance
macros.desc: Use Recklessness from Berserker Stance; otherwise the first press swaps stance. Its cooldown is independent of Shield Wall and Retaliation.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Recklessness
/cast [stance:3] Recklessness; Berserker Stance
macros.needs: Recklessness learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Temeridade
/cast [stance:3] Temeridade; Postura de Berserker

macros.title: Bloodrage and Berserker Rage
macros.desc: Start a pull with Bloodrage and Berserker Rage together. Improved Berserker Rage adds Rage the moment you use it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Berserker Rage
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast Bloodrage
/cast Berserker Rage
macros.needs: Berserker Stance; Improved Berserker Rage for instant Rage
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raiva Incontrolada
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast Fúria Sanguinária
/cast Raiva Incontrolada

macros.title: Mouseover Pummel
macros.desc: Start attacking and Pummel the enemy under your cursor, or your target, from Berserker Stance.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Pummel
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Pummel
macros.needs: Pummel learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Murro
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Murro

macros.title: Mouseover Taunt
macros.desc: Taunt the enemy under your cursor without dropping your current target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Taunt
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Taunt
macros.needs: Defensive Stance and Taunt learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Provocar
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Provocar

macros.title: Mouseover Shield Bash
macros.desc: Interrupt a nearby caster under your cursor, or your target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shield Bash
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Shield Bash
macros.needs: Shield equipped; Shield Bash learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Trombada com Escudo
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Trombada com Escudo

macros.title: Mouseover Sunder Armor
macros.desc: Sunder your mouseover or target for armor reduction and threat. It remains usable for threat under a stronger Expose Armor.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Sunder Armor
/startattack
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Sunder Armor
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fender Armadura
/startattack
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Fender Armadura

macros.title: Revenge, Shield Block on Shift
macros.desc: Revenge when a block, dodge or parry lets you. Hold Shift to Shield Block first, which now blocks up to 2 attacks over 7 sec.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Revenge
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift,equipped:Shields] Shield Block
/cast Revenge
macros.needs: Shield equipped; Defensive Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Revanche
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift,equipped:Escudos] Levantar Escudo
/cast Revanche

macros.title: Shield Slam, Revenge, Sunder Armor
macros.desc: Shield Slam when it's ready, then Revenge after a block, dodge or parry, then Sunder Armor.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shield Slam
/startattack
/cast Shield Slam
/cast Revenge
/cast Sunder Armor
macros.needs: Shield Slam talent; shield equipped; Defensive Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Escudada
/startattack
/cast Escudada
/cast Revanche
/cast Fender Armadura

macros.title: Thunder Clap from Defensive Stance
macros.desc: Thunder Clap works from Defensive Stance, so tanks don't have to swap to Battle Stance. Pressed from Berserker Stance it swaps you to Battle Stance instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Thunder Clap
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Thunder Clap; Battle Stance
macros.needs: Battle or Defensive Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Trovoada
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Trovoada; Postura de Batalha

macros.title: Shield Wall, Last Stand on Shift
macros.desc: Swap to Defensive Stance if needed and use Shield Wall (60% less damage for 12 sec). Shift adds Last Stand. Shield Wall's 15 minute cooldown is independent of Retaliation and Recklessness.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shield Wall
/cast [mod:shift] Last Stand
/cast [nostance:2] Defensive Stance
/cast Shield Wall

keys.text: Shield Wall, swapping to Defensive Stance first
Last Stand and Shield Wall together

macros.needs: Shield equipped; Last Stand talent for Shift
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Muralha de Escudos
/cast [mod:shift] Último Recurso
/cast [nostance:2] Postura de Defesa
/cast Muralha de Escudos

macros.title: Charge and Bloodrage from Defensive Stance
macros.desc: Charge without leaving Defensive Stance, then Bloodrage as you land. Charge goes first because Bloodrage counts as being in combat.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Charge
/dismount
/cast [nocombat] Charge
/cast [nocombat] Bloodrage
macros.needs: Vanguard talent; Defensive Stance; out of combat
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Investida
/dismount
/cast [nocombat] Investida
/cast [nocombat] Fúria Sanguinária

macros.title: Swap to sword and board
macros.desc: Put your one-hander and shield on and drop into Defensive Stance. Put your own weapon and shield names in place of One-Hand Name and Shield Name.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Defensive Stance
/equipslot [noequipped:Shields] 16 One-Hand Name
/equip [noequipped:Shields] Shield Name
/cast [nostance:2] Defensive Stance
macros.needs: A one-handed weapon and a shield in your bags
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Postura de Defesa
/equipslot [noequipped:Escudos] 16 Nome da Arma de Uma Mão
/equip [noequipped:Escudos] Nome do Escudo
/cast [nostance:2] Postura de Defesa

macros.title: Battle Stance into mouseover Mocking Blow
macros.desc: Switch to Battle Stance, then Mocking Blow a hostile mouseover or target. Press again after the stance cooldown if needed. Its brief forced attack is different from Taunt's threat match.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mocking Blow
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
/cast [stance:1,@mouseover,harm,nodead][stance:1,harm,nodead] Mocking Blow
macros.needs: Mocking Blow learned; enough Rage after the stance change
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Zombeteiro
/cast [nostance:1] Postura de Batalha
/cast [stance:1,@mouseover,harm,nodead][stance:1,harm,nodead] Golpe Zombeteiro

macros.title: One-button interrupt
macros.desc: Shield Bash with a shield in Battle or Defensive Stance, Pummel in Berserker Stance. Without a shield it swaps you to Berserker Stance first. It also stops your own Slam.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead,equipped:Shields,stance:1/2] Shield Bash; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead,stance:3] Pummel; [equipped:Shields,stance:1/2] Shield Bash; [stance:3] Pummel; Berserker Stance
macros.needs: Shield Bash and Pummel learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead,equipped:Escudos,stance:1/2] Trombada com Escudo; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead,stance:3] Murro; [equipped:Escudos,stance:1/2] Trombada com Escudo; [stance:3] Murro; Postura de Berserker

macros.title: Intercept your target or mouseover
macros.desc: Swap to Berserker Stance if needed and Intercept for a 3 sec stun. Hold Shift to pick your mouseover.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Intercept
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Intercept; Intercept
macros.needs: Intercept learned; Berserker Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Interceptar
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Interceptar; Interceptar

macros.title: Intercept, then Hamstring when you land
macros.desc: Swap to Berserker Stance if you need to and Intercept for the 3 sec stun. Press again once you reach them to Hamstring before they can run.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Intercept
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast Intercept
/cast Hamstring
macros.needs: Intercept learned; Berserker Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Interceptar
/startattack
/cast [nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast Interceptar
/cast Cortar Tendão

macros.title: Hamstring, Piercing Howl on Ctrl
macros.desc: Slow your target, or your mouseover with Shift. Ctrl dazes everything close to you with Piercing Howl instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Hamstring
/startattack
/cast [mod:ctrl] Piercing Howl; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Hamstring; Hamstring

keys.text: Piercing Howl on everything near you

macros.needs: Battle or Berserker Stance for Hamstring; Piercing Howl talent for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cortar Tendão
/startattack
/cast [mod:ctrl] Uivo Perfurante; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Cortar Tendão; Cortar Tendão

macros.title: Intimidating Shout without swinging
macros.desc: Stop your auto attack so you don't hit the enemies you just scared, then Intimidating Shout your target, or your mouseover with Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Intimidating Shout
/stopattack
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Intimidating Shout; Intimidating Shout

keys.text: Scare your target and the enemies near it

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Brado Intimidador
/stopattack
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Brado Intimidador; Brado Intimidador

macros.title: Intimidating Shout, bandage on Shift
macros.desc: Stop swinging and Intimidating Shout your target, then hold Shift to bandage yourself while they run. Damage breaks the bandage, so watch for DoTs. Put in the bandage you carry.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/stopattack
/use [mod:shift,@player] Heavy Runecloth Bandage
/cast [nomod] Intimidating Shout

keys.text: Stop attacking and Intimidating Shout your target

macros.needs: First Aid; Heavy Runecloth Bandage, or swap in the bandage you carry
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopattack
/use [mod:shift,@player] Bandagem Grossa de Runatrama
/cast [nomod] Brado Intimidador

macros.title: Disarm from Defensive Stance
macros.desc: Swap into Defensive Stance if you aren't in it and Disarm your target for 10 sec, or your mouseover with Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Disarm
/cast [nostance:2] Defensive Stance
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Disarm; Disarm
macros.needs: Disarm learned; Defensive Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Desarmar
/cast [nostance:2] Postura de Defesa
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Desarmar; Desarmar

macros.title: Nearest enemy, or back to your last one
macros.desc: Pick the nearest enemy if you don't have a live one and start attacking. Hold Shift to go back to your previous enemy instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Attack
/targetlastenemy [mod:shift]
/targetenemy [nomod,noharm][nomod,dead]
/startattack

keys.text: Target the nearest enemy if needed, then attack
Go back to your last enemy target and attack

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Atacar
/targetlastenemy [mod:shift]
/targetenemy [nomod,noharm][nomod,dead]
/startattack

macros.title: Drop Blessing of Protection and attack
macros.desc: A friendly Paladin's Blessing of Protection stops you attacking. This cancels it and starts your swings again.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Attack
/cancelaura Blessing of Protection
/startattack
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Atacar
/cancelaura Bênção de Proteção
/startattack

macros.title: Berserker Rage, trinket on Ctrl
macros.desc: Berserker Rage against Fear and Incapacitate, swapping to Berserker Stance first if needed. Hold Ctrl to use your top trinket instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Berserker Rage
/cast [nomod:ctrl,nostance:3] Berserker Stance
/cast [nomod:ctrl] Berserker Rage
/use [mod:ctrl] 13

keys.text: Berserker Rage, swapping stance first if needed

macros.needs: Berserker Stance; a PvP trinket in your top trinket slot for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raiva Incontrolada
/cast [nomod:ctrl,nostance:3] Postura de Berserker
/cast [nomod:ctrl] Raiva Incontrolada
/use [mod:ctrl] 13

macros.title: Will to Survive, trinket on Ctrl
macros.desc: Human racial that removes all Stun effects. Hold Ctrl to use your top trinket instead and keep the racial for later.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Will to Survive
/cast [nomod:ctrl] Will to Survive
/use [mod:ctrl] 13
macros.needs: Human; a PvP trinket in your top trinket slot for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Desejo de Sobreviver
/cast [nomod:ctrl] Desejo de Sobreviver
/use [mod:ctrl] 13

macros.title: Free Action Potion, Swiftness Potion on Shift
macros.desc: Drink a Free Action Potion before a root or stun lands, or a Swiftness Potion with Shift to catch a runner. Potions share a cooldown, so it's one or the other.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use [mod:shift] Swiftness Potion; Free Action Potion
macros.needs: Free Action Potion and Swiftness Potion in your bags (Alchemy crafts)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use [mod:shift] Poção de Rapidez; Poção de Ação Desimpedida

macros.title: All three stances on one key
macros.desc: Battle Stance on a plain press, Defensive with Shift and Berserker with Ctrl. Stances have a 1 sec cooldown and you keep up to 10 Rage when you swap.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Defensive Stance; [mod:ctrl] Berserker Stance; Battle Stance
/cast [mod:shift] Defensive Stance; [mod:ctrl] Berserker Stance; Battle Stance
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Postura de Defesa; [mod:ctrl] Postura de Berserker; Postura de Batalha
/cast [mod:shift] Postura de Defesa; [mod:ctrl] Postura de Berserker; Postura de Batalha

macros.title: The big cooldown for your stance
macros.desc: Retaliation in Battle Stance, Shield Wall (15 min cooldown now) in Defensive Stance with a shield, Recklessness in Berserker Stance. In Defensive Stance without a shield it swaps you to Battle Stance.

#showtooltip
/cast [stance:1] Retaliation; [stance:2,equipped:Shields] Shield Wall; [stance:2,noequipped:Shields] Battle Stance; [stance:3] Recklessness

macros.codePt:

/equip [noequipped:Shields] Shield Name
/cast [nostance:2] Defensive Stance
/cast Shield Wall

macros.codePt:

/cast [nostance:2] Postura de Defesa
/cast Muralha de Escudos

/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Mortal Strike; Mortal Strike

macros.codePt:

/equip [equipped:Shields] Two-Hander Name
/cast Mortal Strike

macros.codePt:

macros.desc: Use it when two enemies stand together, like a healer next to your target. Sweeping Strikes is off the global cooldown, so both go out on one press if you have 60 Rage.
macros.code:

/startattack
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
/cast Sweeping Strikes
/cast Mortal Strike

macros.desc: Swap to Battle Stance if needed and Overpower the enemy who dodged, or your mouseover with Shift. With Bloodthrill, enemies carrying your Rend can open it too.

#showtooltip Overpower
/startattack
/cast [nostance:1] Battle Stance
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Overpower; Overpower

#showtooltip Spearing Strike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Spearing Strike; Spearing Strike

/startattack

/cast [nocombat] Charge
